clips.title: The story
paras: In Duskwood, Viktori Prism'Antras looks beyond the canopy for answers to the forest's curse. He trusts observation over arcane superstition and asks you to gather parts for a telescope drawn up by his gnomish associate.

Viktori Prism'Antras sees Duskwood's troubles differently from many in fearful Darkshire. He doubts that black magic, curses, and restless dead alone explain the land's corruption. He believes answers may lie above the canopy. With blueprints from his gnomish partner, Cog, he plans to build an instrument for looking into the heavens.

Viktori needs a sturdy frame to begin building the stargazing instrument. Cog's plans call for a machined bronze tube, and Viktori asks you to find one. He trusts practical engineering and careful observation to shed light where mysticism has failed.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: My Gnomish friend, Cog, has promised to help me build a device which will let me peer towards the stars. A truth exists, beyond magic, that can explain the strange transformation in the forest.
Bring to me a bronze tube made by a skilled engineer. That is the first step, according to Cog's blueprint.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you found a skilled engineer to create a bronze tube yet?

clips.title: Completion
paras: This is perfect, friend. The first step is complete!
